scope_guards: AQMA designation concerns specified objectives and is not a generic parcel pollution score.
Declared and revoked AQMA records remain distinct and current status must be checked.
National AQMA geometry is not an HMLR title or development red-line.
An AQMA intersection is not an automatic planning refusal or permission outcome.
WMS and dataset availability do not prove a candidate-specific overlay or measured concentration.
AQMA, Clean Air Zone and smoke-control regimes are not treated as interchangeable.
Area-level air-quality evidence is not converted into health, viability or delivery probability.
No score or promotion is written without exact pollutant, status, geometry, planning and title evidence.
